questions.question: To whom does Ezekiel 36 prophesy restoration?
options: All of the nations surrounding the whole holy land
The priests and the Levites who serve in the temple
The great city of Babylon and all of its captives
The mountains of Israel and the house of Israel
questions.answer: The mountains of Israel and the house of Israel

questions.question: What new gift does God promise in Ezekiel 36?
options: Broad new lands stretching out far beyond all the old borders
A righteous king to sit upon the throne of David
A grand new temple to replace the one laid waste
A new heart and a new spirit, removing the heart of stone
questions.answer: A new heart and a new spirit, removing the heart of stone
